arguments.name: queue-work-handoff
arguments.body:
State: The user reports the queue work is done. The settled decision is to repartition by the higher-cardinality key; consumer autoscaling stays off for this queue.
Reasoning: Evening traffic concentrated on one partition. Scaling consumers helped briefly, then increased contention on that partition. Repartitioning addresses the partition-key bottleneck.
Blockers: No queue blockers are recorded. Other project notes contain unresolved items, but their relationship to the queue is not established and their status has not been changed.
Next concrete step: Hand the completed queue work and linked diagnostic history to the incoming owner. No further queue action was requested; deployment or post-change validation details were not supplied.

arguments.name: queue-resolution-reasoning
arguments.summary: Evening backlog prompted a consumer-scaling attempt. Extra consumers briefly helped but increased contention on the same partition. The partition key concentrated evening traffic, establishing the reason to repartition by a higher-cardinality key and leave autoscaling off. The user reports queue work complete; the backlog observation is historical. These records preserve the diagnostic reasoning for handoff.
